scope: All 14 actual GP41 captures from the final camera-clearance build, including both GP prototype chains; each file is byte-identical to its individually inspected prior d90 capture. Controlled production-model fixture; no main-app/race/FPS claim.

review_method.method: Per-capture SHA-256 comparison with previously individually displayed and inspected PNG originals. All matched files reuse their corresponding visual observations; no new display pass is claimed.

captures.observation: High-detail GP-R1 retains the red authored fairing, louver openings, thin metal component highlights, treadless tires and tucked leather-clad rider. No large new geometry obstruction is visible. The complete chain route is mostly hidden from this three-quarter angle.
captures.observationProvenance: Individual local image inspection preserved in motocross-release-validation/gp41/visual-review.json; reused only after full-file SHA-256 equality.

captures.observation: The middle LOD retains the silhouette, louver area, rider helmet graphics and dark boot/hand contact regions, with a visibly simpler front wheel and component detail.

captures.observation: The far LOD keeps the bike/rider massing and red/black color separation. Faceted tires, simplified helmet and reduced gear detail are apparent at this deliberately close comparison distance.

limits: The three-quarter angle does not expose the complete chain route; focused CPU cases separately validate geometry, bounds, resource ownership and replay-driven phase.
The existing translucent windscreen softens some display contrast, especially on GP-R2, while all four production instruments pass their nine visibility samples.
LOD comparison captures place every model at the same close viewpoint; visibly simpler far-detail tires and gear are intentional comparison evidence.
